where.if: AND GREATEST(pay_0, pay_2, pay_3, pay_4, pay_5, pay_6) >= #{minDelay}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(default_flag) AS bad, ROUND(AVG(limit_bal), 0) AS avg_limit, ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS avg_age FROM t_client
SELECT GREATEST(pay_0, pay_2, pay_3, pay_4, pay_5, pay_6) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(default_flag) AS bad FROM t_client GROUP BY d ORDER BY d
SELECT ((pay_0 > 0) + (pay_2 > 0) + (pay_3 > 0) + (pay_4 > 0) + (pay_5 > 0) + (pay_6 > 0)) AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(default_flag) AS bad FROM t_client GROUP BY k ORDER BY k
SELECT sex, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(default_flag) AS bad FROM t_client GROUP BY sex ORDER BY sex

SELECT CASE WHEN age < 25 THEN '25岁以下' WHEN age < 35 THEN '25-34岁' WHEN age < 45 THEN '35-44岁' WHEN age < 55 THEN '45-54岁' ELSE '55岁以上' END AS g, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(default_flag) AS bad FROM t_client GROUP BY g ORDER BY MIN(age)
SELECT pay_0 AS s, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(default_flag) AS bad FROM t_client GROUP BY pay_0 ORDER BY pay_0
